## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle late-Míng / early-Qīng commentary-notes by the Chán master **Jīn Shì** 今釋 ([今釋](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%8A%E9%87%8B)) on the bodhisattva-precepts. 隨見錄 *suíjiàn lù* "records of casual observations" indicates the genre — informal exegetical notes accumulated through reading.

**Abstract**

The text reflects the late-Míng tradition of Chán-Vinaya synthesis, integrating Chán meditative practice with bodhisattva-precept observance. Jīn Shì was associated with the Cáodòng 曹洞 lineage of Chán in the late Míng / early Qīng transition.
